answers.goal: My goal is to work in content development with a focus on representation, specifically making sure people of all abilities are actually reflected on screen. That's grown out of real work, not just an interest: research at the Annenberg Inclusion Initiative and leading EDIA efforts at Brand New Theatre showed me how much intention it takes to get representation right, and I want to keep building that into the stories that get made.
answers.drew: Growing up, I was the kid who'd rewatch the same movie just to catch how a scene was built. I'd try my hardest to deconstruct the scene.  That habit never left; now I catch myself doing the same thing with films and shows as an adult, picking apart pacing and structure instead of just watching. That curiosity is basically why I want to be on the development side of things.
